sections.overview: HDFC Gold ETF Fund is an open-ended Gold scheme managed by HDFC. The benchmark index is Domestic Price of Gold.
sections.investment_objective: The Scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Gold Exchange Traded Fund.
sections.fund_house: HDFC Mutual Fund is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company (AMC) Limited, one of India's largest and most trusted mutual fund houses.
sections.benchmark: The benchmark index for HDFC Gold ETF Fund is Domestic Price of Gold.
sections.riskometer: The riskometer classification for HDFC Gold ETF Fund is High. It carries a High risk profile as per regulatory risk-o-meter guidelines.
sections.expense_ratio: The expense ratio for HDFC Gold ETF Fund (Direct Plan) is 0.2%.
